scope: One fortnight's age pension rate for a single person, or for each member of a couple who both receive it, on a day from 20 September 2025 to 19 March 2027, under Pension Rate Calculator A (Social Security Act 1991 s 1064): the maximum payment rate (MBR, pension supplement and energy supplement, per year / 26) less the greater of the reduction for ordinary income and the reduction for assets, not below nil. Income is the stated ordinary income per fortnight plus deemed income from financial assets (s 1082: the below threshold rate up to the deeming threshold and the above threshold rate on the rest, per year / 26); its reduction is 50% of income over the free area, or for a couple 25% of the couple's combined income over their combined free area (s 1064-E2). The assets reduction is $19.50 a year for each whole $250 of assets over the assets value limit for the person's home ownership, a couple's assets halved against each member's limit (s 1064-G2, G4 and G7), per year / 26. Rates are the DSS Social Security Guide's indexed amounts for the day. Excludes rent assistance, the work bonus (the stated income is after it), transitional rates, the blind (Calculator B), illness-separated, respite and partner-not-pensioner couples, residence and portability rules, compensation, deprivation, income streams' own rules and hardship.
